commands.title: Run Code Block in Text Editor
Run Code Block and Below in Text Editor

mdRunbook.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show **▶ Run** links above code blocks in the plain Markdown editor. Off by default: text-editor runs skip per-cell options and secret injection (proposed and assistant-written cells are refused, risky commands still ask).

mdRunbook.report.folder.markdownDescription: Folder for `<name>.report.html` written by **Export Report (HTML)**. Empty = next to the `.md` file. A relative path is resolved against the file's workspace folder (or the file's folder outside a workspace); an absolute path is used as is.
